dragDrop: Drag & drop your match video here
matchNamePlaceholder: Match name (e.g., Team A vs Team B)
noMatches: No matches yet. Upload your first match above!
mwNoDiagnoses: No diagnosis is stored yet. Generating a plan runs the reasoning engine and saves its diagnoses.
mwAwaiting: Waiting for the next two matches. A delta from one match is noise, not evidence.
mwNoRules: The plan carries no measurable diagnosis.
mwUncalibrated: Not calibrated — spatial stats are pixel-based estimates
mwSelectMatch: Select or analyse a match to see its week.
mwBridgeUnavailable: The backend bridge is not available.
mwUnresolvedDrills: Referenced drills missing from the knowledge base:
ebLimits: What this comparison cannot tell you
ebLim_single_match: One match is 90 minutes of football — read the percentile as a single performance, not a season's worth of form.
ebLim_sample_not_league: The reference is a sample of elite matches, not every elite match, and it is not a league average.
ebLim_reduced_feature_model: Benchmark xG comes from a model fitted on this cohort with camera-observable features only; it is not the app's headline xG.
ebLim_in_sample_cohort: The benchmark model is fitted on the cohort it measures, so cohort values are in-sample and a user's shots are out-of-sample.
sbMatchedNote: percentiles compare your {n}-match block against {n}-match blocks drawn from the cohort
ebLim_block_not_season: A block of N matches is a form snapshot, not a full season: the same squad can produce different blocks in different months.
ebLim_matched_block_size: The percentile compares your N-match average against N-match blocks drawn from the cohort, so it answers a stricter question than a single-match comparison.
ebModelCheck: Model check: Brier {b} on {n} shots (lower is better)
ebIntervalNote: sampling band from the cohort size — not a range for the team
ebPlayerNoIdentity: no player identities stored for this match
ebPlayerNote: Percentiles compare player per-90 rates with same-position player-matches in the cohort; they are not a projection.
ebLim_player_minutes_floor: A player needs 30 minutes for a per-90 percentile; shorter appearances are reported with their minutes instead of ranked.
ebLim_position_groups: Players are compared only within their position group (GK/DEF/MID/FWD), never against the whole cohort.
ebLim_player_cohort_sample: The player population is a sample of elite player-matches from the bundled StatsBomb cohort, not every elite appearance.
ebLim_player_in_sample: The benchmark model is fitted on the same cohort, so cohort player xG is in-sample and a user's player is out-of-sample.
